refused_subject_types.listing: watch_target_not_found until a canonical listing identity and visibility contract exists

semantics.actor: server-established active human Joe or Dell, never a request field
semantics.replay: same key and exact payload returns replayed=true; changed actor, verb or payload refuses key_reuse
semantics.baseline: immutable on repeated watch; fresh baseline after unwatch then watch with a new key
semantics.visibility: read and watch refuse unknown or inaccessible targets; list omits them; unwatch still removes the caller's stale subscription
semantics.pagination: limit 1 through 100, default 50; pass next_cursor while has_more=true; live keyset pages
semantics.notification: no notification merely for subscribing; future producer uses canonical notification policy
